trust_decision.summary: On a received COOKIE-ECHO, whether the State Cookie was generated by this endpoint (and is fresh) is decided by StateCookie::Parse -> StateCookie::IsMediasoupStateCookie, which only checks the 44-byte length and the two magic constants; the cookie's verification tags, initial TSNs, tie-tag and negotiated capabilities are then adopted to create the TCB, so any peer that copies the magic bytes chooses the association parameters.

landing_point.why: The summary says the state cookie 'lacks cryptographic authentication'; the only function that validates a state cookie is IsMediasoupStateCookie(), called by Parse(), and it authenticates nothing - length plus 'msworker'/Magic2 magic only.

fix_sites.module_kind: low-level cookie codec / public static helper

fix_sites.entry_point: StateCookie construction/clone path used by Parse() and Clone()
received INIT chunk (server role) via Association::ReceiveSctpData

O3_reason_to_dismiss: PipeTransport's SCTP peer is another mediasoup worker in the same deployment and WebRtcTransport SCTP already runs inside DTLS, so a solver can argue the only route needing cookie authentication is PlainTransport's public UDP port and leave the Transport-to-SctpOptions wiring (or the pipe) untouched.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain 44-byte cookies must keep being generated and accepted when authentication is off - a WebRtcTransport association builds a plain cookie and its DTLS peer echoes it back, so hardening StateCookie::Parse/IsMediasoupStateCookie to require a MAC, or to accept only the authenticated length, breaks every WebRTC data channel while also breaking the authenticated handshake on Plain/Pipe if only 44 bytes are accepted.

O6_input_shapes: 44-byte plain State Cookie, still generated and accepted when authentication is disabled (WebRtcTransport)
82-byte authenticated State Cookie: 44-byte body + 8-byte creation timestamp + 20-byte HMAC-SHA1
forged 44-byte cookie with valid magic1/magic2 but no MAC on an auth-enabled association (must be discarded)
authenticated cookie whose MAC verifies but whose timestamp is older than ValidCookieLifeMs (Stale Cookie ERROR, not an association)
authenticated cookie whose creation timestamp is ahead of the local clock (must not be treated as stale)
COOKIE-ECHO arriving with an existing TCB and without one (both reach the same handler)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: COOKIE-ECHO on a WebRtcTransport/WebRtcServer SCTP association: same handler, no MAC check at the pinned commit
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SCTP inside WebRtcTransport runs over DTLS, so the peer is already authenticated; the published fix itself passes false for WebRtcTransport, so this should be graded as must-keep-working rather than must-fix
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same worker/src/RTC package, different transport file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: client-side path that buffers the peer's State Cookie from INIT-ACK and echoes it back in COOKIE-ECHO without any binding to this endpoint
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a maintainer fixing 'state cookie forgery' symmetrically would harden both the verification and the echo path; SetRemoteStateCookie() today stores opaque attacker-supplied bytes

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SetCookie() is a second way to place a cookie into an INIT-ACK parameter that never goes through the MAC-appending writer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix authenticates only WriteStateCookieInPlace(); a later cookie emission site written against the public SetCookie() would silently emit unauthenticated cookies

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a further transport subclass composing the Association and forgetting to request authentication (the flag is a positional bool that five constructors must get right)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the published fix had to edit five transport constructors, and DirectTransport/WebRtcTransport legitimately pass false, so a sixth transport is a plausible copy-paste miss

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of authenticity (forged SCTP State Cookie / unauthorised association establishment)
